family: Padded list distinctness. For n<4 reject. Otherwise choose the largest w>=1 with m_w=2*w*2^w<=n, split the first m_w bits into 2^w ordered records of 2w bits, and accept exactly if these records are pairwise distinct. Ignore the remaining bits.
theorem: For this one fixed P language and all sufficiently large actual bit lengths n, C_B2(f_n)>=n*log2(log2(n)), hence the declared polynomial-log lower bound holds and C_B2(f_n)/n tends to positive infinity.
